verdict.rationale: Vanta documents official, type-safe SDKs generated from an OpenAPI specification, but only for the Auditor API (vanta-docs-43, vanta-docs-56), which is used by audit firms (vanta-docs-44). The Manage Vanta and integration APIs that most AI-native builders would target (vanta-docs-1, vanta-docs-2) have no documented SDK. Missing for 10: SDKs for the Manage Vanta and integration APIs, documented language coverage and install/usage examples, and independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK quality.
